question: Which bird-women are named as known on earth by devotees?
premises: Devotees know these forms on earth.
The list names owl peacock sarari and gūlī women.
Likewise connects them to prior bird-women.
inference: The verse extends the catalog of bird-women known to devotees.
uncertainties: Exact identity of sararī and gūlī remains unclear.
plain_english: Owl-woman, peacock-woman, or indeed sarari-woman, or gūlī-woman, likewise.
